children: Sweden indoor wireless coverage provider's Q3 net sales grew yr/yr, driven by European demand
EBITDA and operating profit turned positive after losses in prior year
Company disclosed targeted fraud incident, tightened internal financial controls
Company maintains strategic priorities to drive profitable growth and improve cash flow
Maven Wireless enters Q4 with a lower cost base and higher order intake year-to-date
Company continues to invest for growth in new markets and products
EUROPEAN SALES - Majority of Q3 sales came from Europe, with mix of cellular, critical communications and combined products
ONE-OFF AGREEMENT - Gross margin improved to 53%, supported by a one-off agreement without material delivery to a key framework agreement customer
ORDER INTAKE - Q3 order intake increased yr/yr, including 2 new customers in UK and Sweden
Wall Street's median 12-month price target for Maven Wireless Sweden AB is SEK6.00, about 31% above its October 15 closing price of SEK4.58
